DIMO Partnership for Smart Cities

In Oct 2025 @openmind_agi teamed up with DIMO to bring decentralized identity and permissions to city robot fleets

Every OM1 robot now carries a verifiable DIMO ID linked to its on chain reputation
This lets buildings roads and vehicles grant or remove access in real time

A delivery bot enters an apartment lobby on its own
A hospital humanoid gets clearance for restricted wards
No human approval needed

First rollouts are live in Manila and Seoul with over 200 robots using DIMO credentials for elevator access gated communities and traffic priority

This is the base layer for permissionless smart city robotics in 2026
